get.summary: Nodes and edges of the journey agent graph

post.summary: Start (or resume) a demo session
post.description: Creates a private demo account and sets an httpOnly session cookie. A caller that already holds a valid session gets it refreshed instead.

post.summary: End the session

delete.summary: Delete your account and every private record
delete.description: Deletes the account; database cascades remove all private rows (profile, graph, journeys, runs, documents metadata, actions).

post.summary: Complete onboarding
post.description: Saves the profile, household, goals and preferences in one transaction and rebuilds the private user graph from them. Household, goals and preferences replace any earlier answers.

patch.description: Partial update: omitted fields are unchanged; a provided list (household, goals, preferences) replaces the whole set.

schema.title: Response List Generated Api Documents Generated Get

patch.summary: Edit a draft (or restore a discarded one)
patch.description: Saves your text; the document is (again) a draft to review. 409 `generated_document_already_approved` for an approved document.

post.summary: Approve a generated document
post.description: Marks the draft as approved (optionally with your final edits). Approving is idempotent; a discarded draft cannot be approved.

post.summary: Discard a generated draft

Response List Appointments Api Appointments Get

post.summary: Prepare for an appointment
post.description: Builds a checklist from the service's official requirements and your documents, and drafts an appointment brief (a generated document) for you to review. Nothing is booked.

schema.title: Response Agents Catalogue Api Agents Get

post.summary: Start an agent run
post.description: Validates `input` against the agent's schema (see GET /api/agents), creates the run and queues it. Follow progress on `events_url` or `stream_url`.

get.description: Every run the server holds for you (journeys, what-ifs, research, document reading), on any device. `active=true` keeps queued, running and paused runs.

schema.title: Response List Agent Runs Api Agents Runs Get

post.summary: Stop a run that is waiting for you
post.description: Only a paused run (`awaiting_input`) can be cancelled; its open approvals expire and nothing is executed. 409 `run_not_cancellable` otherwise.

get.summary: Agent events (JSON replay, or live Server-Sent Events)
get.description: Returns the run's events after `after` as JSON. With `Accept: text/event-stream` the same events stream live as SSE (`id: <seq>`, `data: <event>`); reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` (or `?after=`) to resume without gaps. The stream ends after `run_completed`, `run_failed` or `run_cancelled`.

post.summary: Read the document again (optionally as a different document type)
Correct what was read and confirm the rest
post.description: Each correction targets a field by name (`value: null` removes it). With `confirm`, every other readable detail from this document is confirmed too. The same operation is available per fact via PATCH/DELETE /graph/user/facts/{id}.

get.summary: The document file (signed, short-lived link; never cached)

Response List Journeys Api Journey Get

post.summary: Start planning a journey
post.description: Creates the journey and queues the journey agent. Follow `events_url`; when the run pauses (`approval_required`), fetch GET /agents/{run_id}/review.

post.summary: Mark a personal preparation step done
post.description: Records a local preparation task as stated by you and re-plans. Official service and appointment steps require provider confirmation; 409 `provider_confirmation_required` if manual completion is attempted.

post.summary: Answer the question a step is waiting on
post.description: Records the answer as a fact you stated (e.g. monthly income) and re-plans. 409 `nothing_to_answer` when the step isn't waiting for anything.

get.summary: What a what-if can change, with the journey's current values

schema.title: Response What If Variables Api Journey  Journey Id  What If Variables Get

post.summary: Simulate a what-if on a copy of the journey
post.description: The journey itself is never changed. The result is stored on a new scenario journey (GET /journey/{scenario_journey_id} → simulation_result).

get.summary: Nodes and edges of the what-if graph
The open review of a paused run
get.description: Render the Review / Approve step from this. 404 `no_pending_review` when the run isn't waiting for the user.

schema.title: Response Read Review Api Agents  Run Id  Review Get

post.summary: Answer the open review and resume the run
Prepare a journey step as an action awaiting your approval (no side effects)

get.summary: Your actions, newest first (each with its approval)

schema.title: Response List Actions Api Actions Get

post.summary: Approve one action
Decline one action
Start background research for the signed-in user
post.description: Queues research and returns immediately. While a job is queued or running the same job is returned (unless `force`). Returns 409 `consent_required` (with `extra.consent`) when the request explicitly asks for faith or community personalisation the user hasn't agreed to.

schema.title: Response List Research Api Research Get

get.summary: A research job and its results

post.summary: Mark the Life Brief notification as seen

patch.summary: Save or unsave a research result

post.summary: Add a research result to the journey
post.description: Returns 409 `journey_required` when the user has no journey yet.

get.summary: The latest Life Brief, grouped into Discover sections

post.summary: Start a voice session
post.description: Mints a short-lived OpenAI Realtime client secret with the session fixed server-side (instructions, tools, turn detection). The browser uses it to open a WebRTC call; the OpenAI API key never leaves the server. Returns `mode: unavailable` when voice can't be offered, and the UI switches to text.

post.summary: Run a tool the voice model called
post.description: Validates the arguments and runs the tool against ADAPT's API as the signed-in user. Always returns an output for the model, including when the tool fails.

post.summary: Text assistant turn (voice fallback)
post.description: Answers a typed message with the same tools voice uses. The client sends recent history, so context carries over from voice; transcripts aren't stored.
